scope: Fourth scrolling group: PageView, SliverAnimatedList with SliverAnimatedListController, SliverAnimatedGrid with SliverAnimatedGridController, and SliverReorderableList with SliverReorderController. Sliver-only animated/reorderable slivers fix their viewport to vertical non-reverse; axis and reverse come from the hosting viewport, not the sliver. Drag-path reorder callbacks are covered by the existing reorderable suite and referenced, not duplicated. Animation presentation stays separate from logical item identity; one controller across unrelated viewports stays a W5 gap. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.
